answer: Give each identity standing only when real peers keep choosing it. Like a vine that lives only while it is climbed, an agent's credentials stay active only if a steady tide of genuine incoming requests arrives from distinct verified counterparties; an umber-stamped ledger records who asked whom, and identities with no inbound demand quietly wither. A Sybil farmer can mint a thousand clones, but cannot fake the attention of independent peers, because each requester spends its own limited budget and reputation when it calls. Clones starve; real agents thrive.
